# acecloud_lb_pool (Resource)

Manages an Ace Cloud Load Balancer Pool.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `lb_algorithm` (String) Load balancing algorithm (ROUND_ROBIN, LEAST_CONNECTIONS, SOURCE_IP).
- `name` (String) Name of the pool. Changing this forces recreation.
- `protocol` (String) Protocol for the pool (HTTP, HTTPS, TCP, UDP, PROXY, PROXYV2).

### Optional

- `description` (String) Human-readable description of the pool.
- `listener_id` (String) ID of the listener this pool belongs to.
- `loadbalancer_id` (String) ID of the load balancer this pool belongs to.
- `session_persistence` (Attributes) Session persistence configuration. Omit to disable. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--session_persistence))
- `tls_ciphers` (String) Colon-separated list of TLS ciphers for backend connections. Only applicable when `tls_enabled` is true.
- `tls_enabled` (Boolean) Whether TLS is enabled for backend member connections. Defaults to `false`.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the pool was created.
- `healthmonitor_id` (String) ID of the health monitor associated with this pool.
- `id` (String) Unique identifier of the pool.
- `operating_status` (String) Operating status (e.g. ONLINE, OFFLINE).
- `provisioning_status` (String) Provisioning status (e.g. ACTIVE, PENDING_CREATE).

<a id="nestedatt--session_persistence"></a>
### Nested Schema for `session_persistence`

Required:

- `type` (String) Persistence type: `SOURCE_IP`, `HTTP_COOKIE`, or `APP_COOKIE`.

Optional:

- `cookie_name` (String) Cookie name. Required when `type` is `APP_COOKIE`.
